stem: A company paid Rs. 6,00,000 as bonus to its employees at different levels A, B and C. Each employee at level A receives one and half times of the amount that was paid to each employee at level B and each employee at level B was paid twice the amount paid to the employee at level C. If 50 employees were on level A, 75 on level B and 100 on level C, how much amount was paid to each employee of level A ?
